title: Origin story: Frostbound Holt
description: Holt was a border warden who volunteered for the winter post no one survived — and survived it, year after year, by learning winter's rules instead of fighting them. The frost bound him as its warden: he patrols the white wastes, rescues the lost, and turns back those who should not pass.
